# Rufus Vane

## Overview

- **Age:** Seventeen years old eighteen years ago (around thirty-five years old at his death)  <sub>[v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v4 c32 P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)</sub>
- **Origin:** The Glen (with family roots in Nova Scotia)  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)</sub>
- **Role:** Store clerk and seasonal sailor  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

In his youth, Rufus was a large, handsome man belonging to a slim build, possessing a high cheek color and pale hair. He shared identical facial features and a distinctive eye quirk with his double cousin Laurence Vane, having one hazel eye and one blue eye.

_Sources: [v4 c32 P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c13 P15](../source/v04-c13.md#nw-v04-c13-p0015)_

## Personality

Rufus was characterized as possessing a small, wicked soul behind a handsome and lively exterior. He was usually pleasant and agreeable when things went well, but grew tired of quiet domestic routine quickly. He was persistent and stubborn in pursuing what he wanted, yet ceased to care for it once obtained.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028)_

- To marry Lorna Ainslie by forcing her consent  <sub>[v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026)</sub>

## History

Rufus Vane grew up in the Glen as the son of storekeeper Abner Vane. He worked as a clerk during the winter and sailed during the summer. Becoming enamored with Lorna Ainslie, he pursued her despite her repeated rejections. Upon realizing she would not willingly consent, he leveraged his father's mortgage on the Ainslie farm to threaten Mrs. Rose Ainslie with foreclosure, coercing Lorna into marrying him. Following their marriage, he lived with Lorna on the Ainslie property for a winter and planted crops in the spring. Soon growing tired of domestic life, he traveled to Nova Scotia and boarded the ship Four Sisters alongside his double cousin Laurence Vane for a voyage to Havana. While in Cuba, Rufus contracted yellow fever and died shortly after the vessel's departure. For eleven years, his local community mistakenly believed that a brain-damaged man brought back from Havana by Captain Saul was Rufus, until Laurence Vane regained his memory and revealed Rufus's true fate.

_Sources: [v4 c11 P24](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0024), [v4 c11 P26](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0026), [v4 c11 P27](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0027), [v4 c11 P28](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0028), [v4 c11 P33](../source/v04-c11.md#nw-v04-c11-p0033), [v4 c32 P3](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0003), [v4 c32 P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006)_
